note: Built-in track splits (P2-10, docs/AI_EVALUATION.md section 5). Training tracks are for evolution; validation tracks are for choosing hyperparameters and champions; held-out tracks are only for the final evaluation of frozen models and are never used for tuning. contentHash is sha256 of JSON.stringify(loadTrack(file)); change a track's version and hash together. P4-04 adds more circuits. P5-02 step 2b adds three fresh held-out circuits (epoch 4) and reclassifies the three circuits E3 opened (hairpin-chicane, long-sweepers, technical-narrow) as validation: they are spent as held-out evidence, and the recorded manifests of epochs 1 to 3 keep their own labels (docs/plans/p5-02-fresh-circuits-plan.md).

tracks.description: Silverstone, imported from the TUM racetrack-database (tracks/Silverstone.csv at commit e59595d1f3573b30d1ded6a08984935b957688e0; LGPL-3.0, centre lines from OpenStreetMap, ODbL 1.0): 1,178 points, a 5.89 km lap, 11.3 to 17.8 m wide, 118 gates; the true layout driven the opposite way round (see src/data/tracks/NOTICE.md).

provenance.designCriteria: A real-world circuit imported by scripts/importSilverstone.mjs from the committed, unmodified source file src/data/tracks/sources/Silverstone.csv (SHA-256 27c51454e81780a75c353d3e6c9f73dbbcd1e82139782e95bd722ade19736e39) with src/tracks/convertRacetrack.ts; a training circuit, so results on it support no generalisation claim. Its version is the source commit (7 characters) and the first 12 hex characters of the source file's SHA-256.

tracks.description: A long straight into a 150-degree left hairpin (radius 28 m), then a gentle right bend (45 m, 40 degrees) and a left bend (60 m, 70 degrees); 9 m wide; 551 m lap; 22 gates. Built by scripts/makeTracks.mjs from specs/hairpin-run.spec.json.

provenance.designCriteria: docs/plans/p5-02-fresh-circuits-plan.md section 3.2 (owner-approved criteria) and docs/plans/p5-02-fresh-circuits-specs.md (the exact half-lap spec, Codex-approved and merged before generation): closed, counter-clockwise, 8 to 14 m wide, 400 to 650 m long, made of straights and arcs by scripts/makeTracks.mjs, with a tight corner (centre-line arc of radius at most 30 m turning at least 90 degrees) and a fast run (at least 150 m straight or arcs of radius at least 70 m), all geometric proxies that guarantee no speed change or lap time for any driver; not matched by any registered circuit; designed after E3's results were seen (disclosed) but before any model, rule or driver was evaluated on it. A held-out circuit: no model is evaluated on it before the one E5 opening.
